title: Frontend: Forgot password page
description: Build the forgot password page where users enter their email to receive a reset link.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows success message regardless of whether email exists

steps.details: src/pages/ForgotPasswordPage.tsx. Email-only form. On submit: show loading, POST /api/auth/forgot-password. On response (success or error): show 'If that email exists, a reset link has been sent.' Always show this message.
Submit with valid email — verify success message. Submit with unknown email — verify same message (no info leak).
